title: Maintain business models
goal: The model says when it is reviewed and what would change it, the feedback that bears on it is gathered and ranked for the founder, and the boxes the founder decided to change are written with their evidence.

steps.do: Write into the validation plan, for each box of the model, the assumption it rests on, the test that would settle it, the result that counts as passing and the date it is judged by, so the model is reviewed on evidence rather than on mood.

Name where feedback about the model comes from, the beta feedback records, the interviews, the open bugs, the competitor signals and the money summary, and write what in each one counts as evidence about a box and what is noise.

Rank the feedback that bears on the model by which box it touches, how many sources say it and what it would cost to act on, bring the founder the ranking with your recommendation, and ask which items the venture acts on now.

Write the boxes the founder decided to change, the solution, what makes it different, the pricing model or the channels, each citing the feedback behind it, and leave a price point and any public claim for the founder to set.

Attach each acted-on item to the decision it settles, raise to the founder any feedback that would change whom the venture serves or how it is paid, and recommend to the strategy lead when the model is reviewed again.

done_criteria.check: Does every box changed in this run cite the feedback record behind it, and does every box of the model have an assumption in the validation plan with a test and a date?
